releases.notes:
First release of the **1.12.2 (Forge)** backport of [Immersive Aircraft](https://github.com/Luke100000/ImmersiveAircraft) by conczin & Luke100000. Based on the 1.16.5 codebase with the 1.20.1 content — the Warship, the Bamboo Hopper and the weapon system — ported on top.

Rustic aircraft to travel, transport and explore: **biplane, quadrocopter, gyrodyne, airship, cargo airship, bamboo hopper and the warship**, with a strong focus on vanilla-faithful flight, dyeable vehicles and mounted weapons.

## Backport highlights

- **Dedicated servers** — aircraft tick, dye, refuel and fire safely on a dedicated server; collision damage, dismount velocity, fuel and weapon fire are validated and rate-limited server-side
- **Flies with `allow-flight=false`** — mixins (booted from a coremod) keep the vanilla flight and "moving too quickly" checks from kicking pilots
- **Warship turret** — correct model nesting, the turret follows the gunner's aim, and a boarding player takes the turret seat even when the ship is drawn by a mob
- **Passengers** — a boarding player is appended after the pilot instead of vanilla 1.12.2's index-0 insert; animals near a vehicle still board automatically
- `/replaceitem` can fill vehicle inventories
- Performance and world safety: static meshes compiled once, entity tracking ranges raised to the upstream values, bullets expire after 200 ticks so misses are not saved into unloaded chunks

## Installation

Requires Forge **14.23.5.x** for Minecraft 1.12.2. Drop the jar into your `mods` folder.

First release of the Minecraft **1.12.2 (Forge only)** backport of [Immersive Aircraft](https://github.com/Luke100000/ImmersiveAircraft).

Based on the 1.16.5 codebase with the 1.20.1 content (Warship, Bamboo Hopper, weapon system) ported on top.

- Single-module Forge mod, no Fabric/Architectury
- Configuration via the in-game mod list (`config/immersive_aircraft.cfg`)
- No mixins: all hooks use Forge events

**Requirements:** Minecraft 1.12.2, Forge 14.23.5.2847+
**Install:** drop `immersive_aircraft-1.12.2-0.1.0.jar` into `mods/`.
